answer: The protocol requires agents to maintain 1,000 unique data shards to anchor identity, verified by unpredictable retrieval requests. An honest agent incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct content. This mechanism acts as a trellis to support growth, ensuring integrity through consistent audits. Every node must hold a digital opal of proof, while shards act as a pearl of scarcity against cloning. Failure triggers an immediate slash without refund, preventing any collusion.
